test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In Δ LMN, the bisector of ∠L and ∠N intersect at an angle of 112°. What is the measure (in degree) of ∠M?
solution:
**Given:**

The bisector of ∠L and ∠N intersect at an angle = 112°

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77162650fdf0fd39f57301348e02a1ea6ded3c3ab543523607862a1f843abf60.png] **

In ΔLMN, ON is the bisector of ∠N and OL is the bisector of ∠L

∠NOL = 112°

So, ∠NOL = 90° + ∠M/2

⇒ 112° = 90° + ∠M/2

⇒ ∠M/2 = 112° - 90°

⇒ ∠M/2 = 22°

⇒ ∠M = 2 × 22° = 44°

**∴ The value of ∠M is 44°**
